name: Aldabrachampsus
sum: Small two-crested horned crocodile from the Late Pleistocene of Aldabra Atoll, Seychelles.
wsnote: About 2–2.5 m, comparable to the smallest living crocodilians.
holotype: Fragmentary cranial and mandibular remains from Aldabra Atoll (Brochu 2006).
material: Fragmentary skull and jaw remains only.
biology: A small island crocodile with crest-like projections on the skull, like the horns of Voay.
author: Brochu 2006

sources.text: Brochu, Christopher A. 2006. A new miniature horned crocodile from the Quaternary of Aldabra Atoll, western Indian Ocean. Copeia 2006(2): 149–158. doi:10.1643/0045-8511(2006)6[149:ANMHCF]2.0.CO;2
